Good morning, and welcome aboard the Bernina Express to St. Moritz. There are four stops on this trip. The trip is about two and a half hours. There is a restaurant car at the end of the train, with coffee and sandwiches. On your right, there is a beautiful lake. Please stay in your seat when the train is on the bridge. Thank you, and enjoy the view.

Hello, and welcome to Chur. My name is Martin, and I am your guide today. Chur is the oldest town in Switzerland. It is not a big town, but there is a lot to see. In the old part of town, there are small streets and old houses. There is a big church, and there are good cafes. Around the town, there are mountains. Is there a train to St. Moritz? Yes, there is. It is a beautiful trip.

Carlos and his wife are in Milan. They go to Tirano by train. In Tirano, there is a red train to St. Moritz. On the trip, there are mountains and a blue lake. In St. Moritz, there is a small station. They stay there for five days.
